findings.reason: a node would close §7 on a green gate while root-level logs keep being created, leaving §7's headline and §2's artefact table ("a log directory, not the repository root") false and the archive to be re-populated.
findings.text: §7's goal "SLURM job logs leave the repository root" is not produced by its mechanism: `imas_ambix/data/cli.py:663`, `scripts/spine_label_fleet.sh:7`, `scripts/temporal_operator_cycle.sh:10` and `scripts/run_magnetics_era_scorecard.sbatch:7` still write an `--output` into the submitting directory / repository root, and §7 neither names nor covers them

findings.reason: the node must be told whether the count means archived-only or archived-plus-retained-with-a-reason, or it fails a gate that is unsatisfiable as written.
findings.text: the done-when "The archive step's printed list accounts for all 451 files" cannot hold as written, because step 1 retains in place every log whose job is still in squeue (the live serve job's repo-root log is one of the stored 451), and no archive tooling sits inside the declared write scope (`slurm.py`, `cli.py`, the tests covering generated scripts)

findings.reason: the plan should name both logs, since a node updating only the one named leaves half the console message pointing at a path that no longer exists.
findings.text: §7 states the setup command's console message "names `ambix-runtime-check-<engine>-<job>.log`", but `imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:4499-4502` emits two names (`ambix-setup-{engine}-{job_id}.log` and `ambix-runtime-check-{engine}-{runtime_check_job_id}.log`), and the done-when ("names the log under the new directory") cannot catch the second being left stale

findings.reason: §6 refers to §4 in the past tense while the declaration table and f-wil-001's dispatch order ("§6 after §4 and §5") tell a dispatcher §4 is unbuilt, so plan state disagrees with the code it describes and the reading of one section changes the reading of another.
findings.text: §4 has landed (`aa4a09b4` "feat(agent): place watch index on local disk" is an ancestor of HEAD, `imas_ambix/agent/index_placement.py` is present, `imas_ambix/agent/watch.py:68` imports `resolve_index_path`, and the plan's own s4 comments record its reviews and landed repairs in `2fefa896`/`5a1477b0`), yet the declaration table still reads s4 "implementable" and §4's body and write scope still cite `DEFAULT_INDEX_PATH (watch.py:91)`, a symbol that landing deleted
